mcq_fix.s: As of December 2021, what was the total number of Primary Health Centres (PHCs) in India?
mcq_fix.why: 'According to the stated figures' is odd wording; y1decdc1c7dd

patterns: APPSC asks direct number/place items: PHC count (23,391 as of Dec 2021), Palasa kidney centre in Srikakulam.
AP tilt: state hospitals, specialty centres and schemes named with place and outlay; 104/108 services.
UPSC-style statement items on public system being largely curative and states organising health services appear for depth.
App covers norms, committees and telemedicine platforms in more detail than PYQs, mostly in multi-statement form; facts are sound.
